# Customnpcs-Crafting-View

[![QQ group](https://img.shields.io/badge/QQ群-143177705-54B4EF?logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://qm.qq.com/q/SobFcvW6Iu) [![discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1342805340839870514.svg?label=Discord&logo=discord&logoColor=ffffff&color=7389D8&labelColor=6A7EC2)](https://discord.gg/PT54KBC2tj) [![modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=black&color=grey&label=modrinth&suffix=%20downloads&query=downloads&url=https://api.modrinth.com/v2/project/5skiXDDB&style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://modrinth.com/mod/customnpcs-crafting-view)

Shows CustomNPCs crafting recipes in a side panel when opening the Carpentry Bench or Anvil. The recipes can be categorized, searched, and transferred with one - click.

![show](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5skiXDDB/images/fa91bd642b9a16c280b94e36d959aa6ecce0b214.gif)

# Install

A single jar works on **both** original CustomNPCs and CustomNPC+ (auto-detected at runtime). Just install the one file.

- [CustomNpcs](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/custom-npcs) 1.7.10 — [Download](https://modrinth.com/mod/customnpcs-crafting-view/version/1.7.10)
- [CustomNpc+](https://modrinth.com/mod/customnpc-plus) 1.7.10 — same jar, no separate download needed
